items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There weren't people like the Berry Brothers or the Nicholas Brothers, people like that, huh? [INTERVIEWEE] The Berry Brothers, but you had to play their act.

ctx.x: There weren't people like the Berry Brothers or the Nicholas Brothers, people like that, huh?
The Berry Brothers, but you had to play their act. They had music and you had to play their music.
